review.subtitle: Citizen Promaster Navihawk A-T, 41 mm, blue dial with slide rule, steel bracelet. Front relief GLB, round 1.
notes: Built from Citizen's official straight-on render (sharper than the supplied photo, same model and layout); the supplied photo is kept as a reference.

Modelled: brushed case with broad horns and the end link in a recess, crown guard on the right and a shoulder by the left crown, satin bezel with polished chamfers, applied polished batons and small squares with lume, hour and minute hands traced from the render (polished outline, lume inlay), white chronograph needle with its black hooked counterweight, black hub, knurled crowns at 3 and 8, pushers at 2 and 4, three-column bracelet with the house curl.
From the photo map: blue dial, grey city ring, both slide rules, the three subdials with their needles and rims, the date (7) and all print.
The hand stack shows 0.2 mm off the dial centre in the render (parallax); the hands are placed on the dial centre.
